predecessors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
predecessors.text: the central strip of the Frankish lands from the Frisian coast and the Rhine and Scheldt to Burgundy, Provence and northern Italy (Treaty of Verdun, 843)

successors.name: Kingdom of Italy
successors.text: the lands in northern Italy, 'as far south as Rome and Spoleto'

successors.name: Lower Burgundy
successors.text: Charles 'received the Kingdom of Burgundy' and Provence

successors.name: Kingdom of Lotharingia
successors.text: 'Most of the lands north of the Alps ... passed to Lothair II and were called Lotharingia'

ledger.x: 843: the Treaty of Verdun gives Lothair I Middle Francia.
855: Lothair I divides Middle Francia on his deathbed at Prum.
855: Charles, the youngest son, gets the south.
855: Middle Francia ends at Lothair I's deathbed.

wars.name: Carolingian civil war ending at Verdun
wars.outcome: The Treaty of Verdun (August 843) 'ended nearly three years of civil war among the sons of Louis the Pious' and gave the central strip to Lothair I.

certainty.note: The Verdun share is described by rivers and regions, never by a survey; the splits of 855 name kingdoms, not lines.
